svg.title: Fractures per 1,000 people in randomized trials, GLP-1 drug vs placebo or control
svg.desc: Wegovy label, heart outcomes trial: hip or pelvis fractures in women 9.8 vs 2.1 per 1,000 (24 of 2,448 vs 5 of 2,424); age 75 and older 24.2 vs 6.0 per 1,000 (17 of 703 vs 4 of 663). Wegovy liver (MASH) trial: any fracture 4.4% vs 3.3%. Tirzepatide, 11 trials pooled in an ADA 2026 abstract, vs placebo or comparator drugs: 5.8 vs 3.3 per 1,000 (37 of 6,357 vs 13 of 3,883). None of these trials was designed to count fractures.

svg.text: None of these trials was built to count fractures. The SELECT rows are subgroups the label reports; the label

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gives no p-values or overall fracture rate. The tirzepatide pool (odds ratio 1.84, 95% CI 1.02–3.31) is a

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: conference abstract, not a peer-reviewed paper. Zepbound’s and Mounjaro’s labels say nothing about fractures.
